source_category_fallback: unseen (source,category) -> train source majority; unseen source -> train global majority

metric_definitions.macro_f1_fixed_3_labels: Always average easy/medium/hard F1; absent labels contribute 0. Category rows with fewer than 3 true classes should be read with the class-support counts.
metric_definitions.balanced_accuracy_present_true_labels: Average per-class recall over true labels present in the evaluated slice; equivalent to sklearn balanced_accuracy_score without adjusted=True.
metric_definitions.macro_recall_fixed_3_labels: Average recall across all three label IDs; absent labels contribute 0.

artifact_hash_note: Ordinal manifest.training_data_sha256 hashes the combined projected trainer input, not outcomes/train.parquet; the latter is verified through outcome_manifest.artifacts.
